_doc: Search engine crawlers identified in access logs by a user-agent substring and verified by reverse DNS (the host name must end in one of the domains) plus a forward lookup that returns the same IP. Domains are the ones the vendors publish for this check: Google (developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/verifying-googlebot), Bing (bing.com/webmasters/help/how-to-verify-bingbot-3905dc26), Yandex (yandex.com/support/webmaster/robot-workings/check-yandex-robots.html), Baidu (help.baidu.com), Apple (support.apple.com/en-us/119829). Checked tokens are matched case-insensitively in this order; the AI crawlers of seoprobe/core/data/bots.json follow, unverifiable.
